narrative: On the plot. The plot on the peg. His side is named at the top of it, and the hour under the title. On the plot. A paper read at the door and not taken down. One title.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played Egeon, and did not cross the water.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Shown on plot in Egeon, and the second Hercules
